main_text.l: לבט Niph. נלבט Concurbari, Concurbare se: Fut. יִלָּבֵט Conturbabitur, Prov.10.8.10. Aben Esra, Corruet, Pœnas dabit: Quidam, Vapulabit.

לבן Hiph. הִלְבִּין Albuit, Albus evasit: Dealba-vit: Præt. הִלְבִּינוּ Albi evaserunt, Joel.1.7. Fut. יַלְבִּין Albescam, Psal.51.9. Et transitive, Infin. וְלַלְבֵּן Et ad dealbandum, Dan.11.35. Hithp. Futur. וַיִּתְלַבְּנוּ Et dealbabuntur, Dan.12.10.

לָבָן m. Albus: Et interdum substantive, Album, Albor, Gen.30.35. Cōstructum irregulare in Sægol, וּלְבַן־שְׁנַיִם Et albus dentibus, Gen.49.12. Plural. סוּסִים לְבָנִים Equi albi, Zachar.6. v.3. Fœmin. לְבָנָה Alba, Levit.13.24. Plur. פְּצָלוֹת לְבָנוֹת Decorticata alba, Genes.30.37. Et Substantive,
לְבָנָה f. Luna, Jesa.24.23. ab Albedine sic dicta: Pallor enim ac rubedo accidentales ejus colores sunt.
לִבְנָה m. Populus alba, arbor, Gen.30.37. Hos.4.13.
לְבוֹנָה f. Thus, à Candore, Cant.4.14.

לְבָנוֹן m. Libanus mons, à Thuris copia, ut quidam vo-lunt. Præcipuè à cedris præstantissimis laudatus fuit, ex qui-bus propterea Salomon Templum ædificavit, quod inde vocatur Libanus, Zach.11.1. per Metonymiam, quòd ex lignis montis Libani esset exstructum.

לְבֵנָה f. Later, ab albore dictus, quòd dum excoquitur igne, Albescit, Gen.11.3. Item Pavimentum, Pavimen-tatio lateritia: Construct. לִבְנַת סַפִּיר Pavimentatio Sapphiri, Exod.24.10. id est, Pavimentatum Sapphiro, pro lateribus. Est sicut חַשְׁכַּת ab integro חֶשְׁכָּה Tenebræ: Plurale, לְבֵנִים Lateres, Genes.11. v.3. Aff. מִלִּבְנֵיכֶם De lateribus vestris, Exod.5.19.

page.notes: The Hebrew headwords and vowel points are read from a small, slightly blurred scan and are uncertain; I have not marked each form, so they should be checked against the original. The forms לְבָנָה and לִבְנָה in the headwords of the Latin Luna/Populus entries, and the vowel pointing of לְבוֹנָה and לְבֵנָה, are the least certain. The Hebrew running head לב is clear. The line-end hyphens "Dealba-vit", "Pavimen-tatio", "vo-lunt" and "qui-bus" are as printed. The printed "Genef." is transcribed with a plain s as "Genes.", per the long-s rule. No catchword is visible.
